understanding: After global reset top-level scoreboard reconstructs idle WISHBONE reads on observed wb_clk_i edges to check receiver/transmitter FIFOs and shift registers cleared, Divisor Latch 0, LCR 8N1, and IER interrupts disabled, depending on chip-reset bring-up and wishbone monitor.
preconditions: wb_clk_i running with fixed period before wb_rst_i assert and held fixed through reset-state checks
wb_rst_i owned by reset drive with no init_config_sequence before reset-state reads
wishbone_slave_interface monitor active reconstructing only completed ACK reads and flushing in-flight on wb_rst_i
uart_serial_data holds srx_pad_i at documented idle and observes stx_pad_o; modem_control_if holds cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i stable; interrupt_output observes int_o
LCR read uses documented bus pin value 3; Divisor IER IIR LSR pin values remain symbolic pending documented binding
stimulus_steps: DRIVE wb_rst_i to documented active level via reset control
WAIT documented hold duration on observed wb_clk_i edges then DRIVE wb_rst_i to documented inactive level
WAIT documented deassert-to-access delay on observed wb_clk_i edges
READ LCR at wb_adr_i pin value 3 via wishbone_slave_interface driver [f_lcr_addr]
READ Divisor LSB MSB via DLAB-gated access and IER IIR LSR via symbolic addresses through wishbone_slave_interface driver without configuration writes [f_div_zero f_ier_disabled]
SAMPLE int_o via interrupt_output monitor and stx_pad_o idle via uart_serial_data monitor on observed wb_clk_i edges
check_steps: COMPARE LCR read data to 00000011b for 8 bits no parity 1 stop [f_lcr_reset f_lcr_format]
COMPARE IER enables to disabled state where 0 means disabled [f_ier_disabled]
COMPARE LSR DR to 0 meaning no characters in FIFO to confirm FIFOs cleared [f_fifo_cleared f_lsr_dr]
COMPARE IIR bit0 to 1 meaning no interrupt pending with int_o negated to confirm interrupts disabled [f_ier_disabled f_iir_idle]
COMPARE no received or transmitted payload observed after reset to confirm shift registers and FIFOs cleared [f_shift_cleared f_fifo_cleared]
completion: COMPLETE when all reset-state COMPAREs evaluated after wb_rst_i deassert and reads sampled on observed wb_clk_i edges
TERMINATE on TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES operational limit; timeout is testbench limit not DUT timing
